stopping_rules: stop before deployment on any runner, compose, identity-artifact, image or healthy-baseline mismatch
perform exactly one repetition with no adaptive retry or threshold change
stop the replay if the UE does not attach within 180 seconds and preserve runtime and split evidence collected before rollback
stop during observation on any frozen PBCH, PUSCH, random-access, RLC maximum-retransmission, unhandled-RLF, actual-RLF or lost-sync marker
stop if more than ten consecutive CIRDB snapshots are skipped or a log stream is not append-only
always restore the original compose and require the original image IDs, gNB health, unchanged gNB restart count and UE attachment
do not run the standardized time-varying trace, calculate MMD, compare absolute RSRP, infer parameters or run ABC
